name: Remove Background
description: Finds the subject of a picture and gives it as a mask (Remove Background Mask), or as a cutout with a transparent background (the group Remove Background). BiRefNet (code MIT, github.com/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet; its ONNX weights are released by the author under MIT) through ONNX Runtime (MIT), on the CPU or an NVIDIA GPU, in the pack's own Python environment. Nothing is bundled: the model is downloaded from the model picker after a question that names its licence.

setup.description: Create the pack's Python environment (ONNX Runtime for the CPU, NumPy, Pillow) in its folder; needs uv and the network.
